Pilgrimage.name: Pilgrimage
Pilgrimage.blurb: Temples, ghats and sacred circuits at a gentle pace.
Pilgrimage.intro: Sacred journeys planned around darshan timings and aartis, with comfortable stays close to the temples — ideal for travelling with parents and family.

Honeymoon.name: Honeymoon
Honeymoon.blurb: Houseboats, hill views and slow mornings for two.
Honeymoon.intro: Romantic escapes with handpicked stays, private cabs and a few thoughtful surprises along the way.

Family.name: Family
Family.blurb: Easy-paced trips that work for every age.
Family.intro: Comfortable, well-paced holidays with sensible drive times, family-friendly hotels and something for every age.

Hill Station.name: Hill Station
Hill Station.blurb: Pine forests, tea estates and cool mountain air.
Hill Station.intro: Mountain air, tea estates and snow-capped views — our favourite hill escapes, from Kashmir to the Western Ghats.

Beach.name: Beach
Beach.intro: Sun, sand and seafood along India's coastlines, from quiet shores to lively beach towns.

Wildlife.name: Wildlife
Wildlife.blurb: Safaris, national parks and forest stays.
Wildlife.intro: Jungle safaris, national parks and forest lodges for travellers who love the wild side of India.

Weekend.name: Weekend
Weekend.blurb: Short breaks that fit into two or three days.
Weekend.intro: Short getaways that fit neatly into a long weekend, with minimal travel time and maximum holiday.
